reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin packages costing €100 to €12,500, a €30 membership activation, and a signup link while associating paid tiers with profit language and projected future price increases. It also invites viewers to start mining, although the material does not establish that purchases, mining, or projected values produced realized gains or losses.

citations.quote: At the moment, we have 6 different types of packets which can be bought in Euros
As OneCoin member, you are able to get tokens that you can place in the central mining process to generate coins there.
you can calculate the bill and see the level reach the 10 to 15 euro limit. Simply put, you can make the calculation yourself, see the value of each package and calculate your earnings.
It is also very useful that the cryptocurrency coin will be launched via the networking marketing model

opening.argument: The presentation treats future value as uncertain commentary rather than a guaranteed result. It expressly says that no one knows what the future holds and that the presenter cannot take responsibility. Its growth discussion is framed through scenarios, including an optimistic scenario and a base scenario, while the narration describes €10–15 as an expectation rather than a promised outcome. That uncertainty matters: discussing possible appreciation and inviting viewers to calculate hypothetical earnings is not the same as guaranteeing a return or concealing risk.

citations.quote: Since no one knows what the future has in store, we surely cannot take any responsibilities.
the expectation is that the OneCoin will even reach €10-15 next year

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution emphasizes prices, tokens, and earnings, but those excerpts do not establish that any return was guaranteed. The presentation expressly limits responsibility for future outcomes, and its value discussion uses projections and expectations. A paid package can be discussed alongside risk disclosures without the material certifying that purchases or mining will produce gains.

citations.quote: we surely cannot take any responsibilities.
the predictions are added and the expectation is that the OneCoin will even reach €10-15 next year

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclaimer does not neutralize the commercial message. The same presentation connects membership tokens to generating coins and tells viewers to calculate earnings from package values. Calling the figures expectations leaves the persuasive profit prospect intact; it does not show that the paid mining mechanism actually works or that projected value is independently established.

citations.quote: As OneCoin member, you are able to get tokens that you can place in the central mining process to generate coins there.
you can make the calculation yourself, see the value of each package and calculate your earnings.

opening.argument: The material is presented as an instructional introduction to cryptocurrency concepts and the OneCoin model. The description calls it an educational video, and the speaker says the presentation will explain the concept across 16 sheets. It explains algorithms, mining, token conversion, cryptocurrency history, and the difference between Bitcoin and OneCoin. The inclusion of curriculum and tests on currency-related subjects further supports an educational and operational-demonstration reading, even though the presentation also contains promotional material.

citations.quote: In this comprehensive and very interesting, educational video
In 16 sheets of material, I will explain the OneCoin concept.
there are a maximum of six different courses that you can follow in the OneAcademy
with tests on budgets, obligations, purchase and sale of currency

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution identifies commercial details, but explaining how a proposed cryptocurrency operates does not by itself turn an educational presentation into a deceptive solicitation. The material teaches concepts such as algorithms, mining, and token use, and the prosecution does not show that the speaker concealed the instructional nature or represented completed returns.

citations.quote: I will explain the OneCoin concept.
the curriculum is also being taught

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Educational formatting does not change what viewers are being invited to buy. The presentation describes packages, membership activation, and tokens placed into a mining process to generate coins. A lesson can simultaneously function as a sales pitch; the instructional slides do not establish that the paid offer is legitimate or merely hypothetical.

citations.quote: it costs 30 Euro to active your membership
As OneCoin member, you are able to get tokens that you can place in the central mining process to generate coins there.

opening.argument: The offer can be understood as a paid digital service with tiered access and token quantities. The speaker calls OneCoin a mining service business, explains that members receive tokens for use in the central process, and lists different packages with different token allocations. The supplied material does not state that returns are guaranteed, require a deposit repayment, request credentials, or promise income from recruiting a downline. The existence of prices and a referral link therefore shows commerce and marketing, but does not alone establish a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: OneCoin is a mining service business.
One way to join the team is by buying a package.
They vary from 100 euros to 12.500 euros and it costs 30 Euro to active your membership.
As OneCoin member, you are able to get tokens that you can place in the central mining process to generate coins there.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats package sales and networking language as proof of a scam, but those facts are also consistent with ordinary paid access to a claimed service. Its excerpts do not show a guaranteed return, a demand for financial credentials, or a requirement that viewers recruit others to qualify. A signup path and package comparison are evidence of promotion, not conclusive evidence of deception.

citations.quote: OneCoin is a mining service business.
It is also very useful that the cryptocurrency coin will be launched via the networking marketing model

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing elements are not necessary when the central offer itself ties paid packages to mining returns. The material says members buy packages, receive tokens, place them in mining, and calculate earnings from package value. Calling this a service does not verify that the promised coins or projected gains are real, while the referral and network framing reinforces the promotional character.
